days.file: Brooklyn Museum - Saint Peter Walks on the Sea (Saint Pierre marche sur la mer) - James Tissot - overall.jpg
days.title: Saint Peter Walks on the Sea
days.alt: Peter, sinking waist-deep in dark water at night, raises both hands toward Jesus, who stands in white and reaches out to him.
days.look: Look again at the hand stretched out to Peter across the dark water. What would you let Him hold today?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: San tommaso d'aquino con la summa, angelico san marco.jpg
days.title: Saint Thomas Aquinas with the Summa
days.alt: St. Thomas Aquinas, in a black Dominican cloak with a golden star on his chest, holds an open book before him.
days.look: Look again at the open book in Thomas’s hands. What work will you offer to God before you open yours?
days.license: Artist died 1455; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Albrecht Dürer - Jesus among the Doctors - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Jesus among the Doctors
days.alt: A boy with long hair, Jesus, stands among old scholars holding heavy books, counting on his fingers as they lean in to listen.
days.look: Look again at the boy among the scholars, his hands raised as he explains. What would you ask God to help you understand?
days.license: Artist died 1528; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Antonello da Messina - St Jerome in his study - National Gallery London.jpg
days.title: Saint Jerome in His Study
days.alt: St. Jerome, in a red robe, sits at a raised desk in a quiet library, reading by the window light.
days.look: Look again at Jerome at his desk, absorbed in his book. What ordinary piece of work can you do heartily today?
days.license: Artist died 1479; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Ferdinand Bol - Elijah Fed by an Angel - WGA2360.jpg
days.title: Elijah Fed by an Angel
days.alt: The prophet Elijah lies worn out on the ground, looking up, as an angel bends over him and touches his shoulder.
days.look: Look again at the angel’s hand on the tired prophet’s shoulder. What would it mean to let God care for you tonight?
days.license: Artist died 1680; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - Zacchaeus in the Sycamore Awaiting the Passage of Jesus (Zachée sur le sycomore attendant le passage de Jésus) - James Tissot.jpg
days.title: Zacchaeus in the Sycamore Awaiting the Passage of Jesus
days.alt: Zacchaeus, in a yellow robe, leaps along a tree branch above the crowd to see Jesus, who stands in white among his followers.
days.look: Look again at Zacchaeus, out on a limb to see Jesus. He would soon repay what he had taken; where is God asking you to choose the honest way?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Jaume Huguet - Last Supper - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Last Supper
days.alt: Jesus, seated at the centre of the table, raises one hand beside a chalice while the apostles gather close around Him.
days.look: Look again at Jesus’ raised hand at the table. Where do you need His peace most on exam day?
days.license: Artist died 1492; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - The Sermon of the Beatitudes (La sermon des béatitudes) - James Tissot.jpg
days.title: The Sermon of the Beatitudes
days.alt: Jesus, in white, stands high on a rocky hillside with arms raised, teaching the crowd gathered below him.
days.look: Look again at Jesus teaching the crowd on the hillside. How could your work today give glory to the Father?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Brooklyn Museum - The Healing of Ten Lepers (Guérison de dix lépreux) - James Tissot - overall.jpg
days.title: The Healing of the Ten Lepers
days.alt: Jesus stands in white on a hillside, raising his hand toward the bandaged lepers who kneel or lie on the ground, crying out to him from a distance.
days.look: Look again at the lepers calling to Jesus from afar. They set out before they saw any healing; where is God asking you to trust him before you see the way?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
